Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.
The Company operates Snapchat , a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc. , a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji , Saturn, and other digital services.
Specs Inc. is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Snap Inc. dedicated to making computing more human. The company develops Specs, advanced eyewear that seamlessly integrates digital experiences into the physical world.
Specs feature see-through lenses that place digital objects directly into three-dimensional space, powered by Snap OS, a proprietary, context-aware operating system designed for natural interaction with your hands and voice.
Specs Inc. also provides Lens Studio, a full suite of advanced developer tools that powers immersive augmented reality experiences across Specs, Snapchat, and other services.
We’re looking for an Embedded Software/Firmware Engineer to join the Spectacles team!
What you’ll do
Develop embedded software and firmware for micro-display systems, display chips, and related tools with clear ownership scope across implementation, integration, validation, and release
Design, implement, and validate software features for display ASICs, modules, microcontrollers, and host-side tools
Set up, maintain, and improve embedded software and firmware build environments, build flows, and development tooling for efficient validation and release
Build test plans and test code to verify new features before release to production and partner teams
Work across emulator, board, and silicon environments to debug and validate system behavior, with strong focus on hardware debuggability, root-cause analysis, and issue isolation at the system level
Collaborate closely with software, firmware, ASIC, EE, and production teams to bring up and verify new hardware and software features
Develop and maintain tools, libraries, interfaces, and build workflows used by internal teams for validation, debugging, and production enablement
Investigate issues across software, firmware, tools, and hardware, and drive root-cause analysis through resolution
Create clear bug reports and Jira tickets for issues related to software, firmware, tools, and hardware interactions
Document software flows, build/setup procedures, test procedures, board/tool usage, and user-facing interfaces for internal developers and partner teams
Contribute to code reviews and help improve code quality, testability, maintainability, and build reliability across software, firmware, and tooling
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
Strong programming skills in C/C++ and Python; C# experience is a plus
Strong understanding of embedded systems, including boards, chips, interfaces, software/firmware interactions, and system-level debuggability
Experience setting up and maintaining build environments, build tools, and development workflows for embedded software, firmware, and related tools
Experience working across hardware and software boundaries, including bring-up, debugging, and validation
Familiarity with communication interfaces such as USB, I2C/I3C, SPI, UART, MIPI, SWD, and PCIe
Ability to work closely with cross-functional teams including EE, ASIC, production, and software partners
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills in complex multi-component systems
Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar tools to improve productivity and development velocity
Great interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively through written, verbal, and visual communication
Minimum Qualifications
BS/BA degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
5+ years of experience in embedded software or firmware development
Experience developing in C/C++ and Python for embedded systems, firmware, or system-level tools
Experience debugging hardware/software integration issues in embedded or consumer electronics systems
Preferred Qualifications
Experience developing software or firmware for display, imaging, or other consumer-electronics systems
Experience with small microcontrollers such as ARM or RISC-V
Experience developing firmware in C/C++ on RTOS or non-RTOS systems
Experience with board bring-up, chip validation, and system-level debugging
Experience building internal tools, validation frameworks, or automation for embedded development workflows
Experience identifying issues across hardware, firmware, and software in mass-produced consumer devices
Knowledge of micro-display systems, video standards, and related protocols such as MIPI, HDMI, and DisplayPort
Experience using lab equipment such as oscilloscopes and logic analyzers
Self-starter who can organize complex issues, drive them to closure, and operate effectively in ambiguous environments
Passion for Snapchat and creativity

We’re looking for a founding Machine Learning Engineer to join the Revenue+ team and help establish machine learning as a core capability for subscription growth and monetization across Snapchat+ subscription. You’ll work on problems such as personalized paywalls, offer decisioning, retention, lifecycle optimization, and subscriber value, with direct and measurable impact on revenue.
What you’ll do:
Identify high-value opportunities where machine learning can improve subscription growth, monetization, retention, and subscriber value
Design, build, and deploy ML systems for personalization, ranking, propensity modeling, offer decisioning, and lifecycle optimization
Own the full path from ambiguous business problem and data exploration through experimentation, production deployment, measurement, and iteration
Establish technical direction and best practices for a new Revenue+ ML capability
Partner closely with Product, Data Science, Backend, and Mobile Engineering to shape product strategy and prioritize ML investments
Build reliable, observable, scalable production ML systems serving Snapchatters at significant scale
Utilize AI tools to design and ship scalable services while upholding rigorous standards for code correctness, security, and production
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
Strong understanding of machine learning and software engineering foundations
Strong product and business judgment, with the ability to identify where ML can create measurable incremental value
Experience with ranking, recommendation, personalization, propensity modeling, decisioning, or related product ML systems
Ability to independently turn ambiguous business problems into concrete ML opportunities and technical plans
Ability to operate with substantial autonomy and take end-to-end technical ownership
Strong collaboration and mentorship skills
Proficiency in, or a strong aptitude for, leveraging AI tools to streamline development, paired with the critical judgment to audit generated output for architectural integrity, performance bottlenecks, and security risks
Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor's Degree in a relevant technical field such as computer science or equivalent years of practical work experience
5+ years of post-Bachelor’s machine learning experience; or Master’s degree in a technical field + 4+ year of post-grad machine learning experience; or PhD in a relevant technical field + 1 years of post-grad machine learning experience
Experience developing and productionizing machine learning systems for ranking, recommendation, personalization, propensity modeling, decisioning, monetization, retention, or other relevant product ML applications
Experience taking ML systems from ambiguous problem statements through experimentation and into production
Preferred Qualifications:
Advanced degree in computer science or related field
Experience with subscription, monetization, pricing, offers, retention, or lifecycle optimization
Experience of extensive collaboration with Backend and Mobile SWEs
Experience with causal inference, uplift modeling, experimentation, customer lifetime value, or incremental impact measurement
Experience optimizing ML systems against business or revenue outcomes
Experience operating production ML systems at significant scale
Experience as an early or founding ML engineer, or in another environment requiring broad technical and product ownership

Snap Security teams protect the trust and safety of our global community by securing the systems and data that power Snapchat. We safeguard hundreds of millions of Snapchatters every day, ensuring that every product and service is built on a foundation of security and resilience. Our values guide everything we do - from how we anticipate and mitigate threats to how we collaborate across Snap. We move fast, with precision, and always execute with privacy at the forefront.
​We’re looking for a Security Engineering Manager to lead and grow our Identity & Access Management organization at Snap!
This role combines strong people leadership, execution, and technical judgment. You will build a high-performing and increasingly independent engineering team, establish clear priorities and operating mechanisms, and partner with IAM technical leaders to deliver secure, reliable, and usable identity and access capabilities across Snap.You do not need to be the deepest IAM architect in the room. You do need enough technical fluency to understand system risk, challenge assumptions, make sound prioritization decisions, and represent the team credibly with engineering and infrastructure partners.
What you’ll do:
Lead, coach, and grow a team of security engineers; set expectations, provide feedback, manage performance, hire thoughtfully, and develop future technical leaders.
Build a healthy, accountable, and increasingly independent team that delivers reliably without depending on individual heroes.
Establish priorities, staffing plans, capacity tradeoffs, operating cadence, and measurable commitments for IAM.
Partner with IAM strategy and technical leaders to translate technical direction into executable plans, clear ownership, safe rollouts, and durable operational mechanisms.
Improve execution across IAM migration, reliability, authorization adoption, workload and machine identity, and internal-customer experience.
Set a high bar for engineering quality, security, reliability, observability, incident response, and operational readiness.
Build alignment with engineering and infrastructure teams, balancing least-privilege security with developer productivity and usability.
Identify organizational, technical, staffing, and dependency risks early; drive resolution or escalate with clear tradeoffs.
Maintain enough working fluency in authentication, authorization, cloud access, workload identity, privileged access, and access governance to make sound decisions and challenge risk.
Help the team use AI tools responsibly while maintaining strong standards for correctness, security, and production quality.
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
Lead, coach, and grow a team of security engineers; set expectations, provide feedback, manage performance, hire thoughtfully, and develop future technical leaders.
Build a healthy, accountable, and increasingly independent team that delivers reliably without depending on individual heroes.
Establish priorities, staffing plans, capacity tradeoffs, operating cadence, and measurable commitments for IAM.
Partner with IAM strategy and technical leaders to translate technical direction into executable plans, clear ownership, safe rollouts, and durable operational mechanisms.
Improve execution across IAM migration, reliability, authorization adoption, workload and machine identity, and internal-customer experience.
Set a high bar for engineering quality, security, reliability, observability, incident response, and operational readiness.
Build alignment with engineering and infrastructure teams, balancing least-privilege security with developer productivity and usability.
Identify organizational, technical, staffing, and dependency risks early; drive resolution or escalate with clear tradeoffs.
Maintain enough working fluency in authentication, authorization, cloud access, workload identity, privileged access, and access governance to make sound decisions and challenge risk.
Help the team use AI tools responsibly while maintaining strong standards for correctness, security, and production quality.
Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent years of experience in a related technical field
8+ years of post- bachelor’s security experience; or a Master’s degree in a technical field + 7+ years of post-grad security experience; or a PhD in a related technical field + 4 years of post-grad security experience
1+ year(s) of experience as an Engineering Manager
Experience leading security initiatives related to identity, access management, or cloud security.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience building or scaling enterprise IAM platforms and cloud access governance solutions.
Familiarity with modern identity standards and protocols such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, and SCIM.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code and security automation frameworks.
Experience partnering with compliance, audit, or risk management organizations.
Strong track record of driving technical strategy and organizational security maturity at scale.
